theme.title: Mixed / Stock-Picker's Market
theme.summary: Energy (+0.85%) and Technology (+0.50%) led the market today, while Industrials (-0.91%) and Financials (-0.88%) brought up the rear. Growth sectors outpaced the rest, averaging +0.24% versus -0.52% for defensives and -0.36% for value, consistent with risk appetite favoring higher-beta names. That shows up at the index level too: the tech-heavy Nasdaq gained +0.76% while the blue-chip Dow lagged at -0.32%. Small caps moved roughly in line with the broader market, with the Russell 2000 at +0.14%. The VIX fell 0.87% to 15.89, which reads as an orderly rotation rather than panic-driven selling. Gold slipped 0.54% to $4,182.60, crude oil was little changed at $90.88, and bitcoin gained 0.55% — cross-asset moves weren't all pointing the same direction as equities.
